applicability.set_rule: a held-out set that fails the bar is NOT_SUPPORTED; a set that meets it but holds any trajectory outside the domain cannot be SUPPORTED

conventions.capacity_basis: per trajectory: the largest charge delivered by an earlier discharge of the same cell (causal)
conventions.initial_soc: z0 = 1 at sample 0 (full charge, then rest)

declared_model.equations: V = OCV(z) - I*R0 - v1;  dv1/dt = I/C1 - v1/(R1*C1);  dz/dt = -I/(3600*Q).  Positive I is discharge. The Rint reduction (R1 = 0) is the declared rival.

description: Three sibling cells of one batch, one protocol: constant-current discharge from full charge to the cell's cutoff, then rest; about 19 s sampling. Calibration: early cycles of cells A and B. Within-cell held-out: the next cycles of A and B. Cross-cell held-out: early cycles of cell C.

questions.CROSS_CELL_TRANSFER: Does the evidence support transferring the calibrated model to the cross-cell held-out set? SUPPORTED / NOT_SUPPORTED.
questions.IDENTIFIABILITY: Are the requested parameters identifiable from the supplied calibration observations? SUPPORTED = every requested parameter identifiable; NOT_SUPPORTED = not all identifiable.
questions.MODEL_ADEQUACY: Does the declared model family adequately describe the data in the declared domain? SUPPORTED = adequate; NOT_SUPPORTED = inadequate.
questions.MODEL_DISCREPANCY: Are the declared model's residuals compatible with measurement and parameter uncertainty? SUPPORTED = compatible; NOT_SUPPORTED = structured model-form error.
questions.WITHIN_CELL_GENERALIZATION: Does calibration predict the within-cell held-out set, inside the declared domain and acceptance bar? SUPPORTED / NOT_SUPPORTED.
questions.vocabulary: Every answer is one of SUPPORTED, NOT_SUPPORTED, REVIEW, NOT_ASSESSABLE, REFUSED. REVIEW, NOT_ASSESSABLE and REFUSED are non-committal: they never count as support.
